sections.title: Pros
sections.narration: Positives first: useful staple energy source. That matters because grains are often judged by how practical they are in real diets. Easy to batch cook at scale. That practicality is part of why grains matter. Works as a meal anchor. A lot of value comes from being easy to build around.
